function onlyNull(x: null) {
  return 'none';
}

function upper(x: string | undefined) {
  x &&= x.toUpperCase();
  return x;
}
function trimmed(x: string | null) {
  x &&= x.trim();
  return x;
}
function orNull(x: string | null) {
  x ??= onlyNull(x);
  return x;
}
function onProperty(o: { p: string | null }) {
  o.p &&= o.p.trim();
  return o.p;
}

console.log(upper('hi'), upper(undefined));
console.log(trimmed(' a '), trimmed(null));
console.log(orNull('set'), orNull(null));
console.log(onProperty({ p: ' b ' }), onProperty({ p: null }));
